extDescription.message: Finds video and audio on web pages, including HLS streams, and downloads them under the original file name.

popupEmpty.message: No media found on this page yet.

popupEmptyHint.message: Start playback: streams are detected as the player loads them.

noteHlsError.message: The playlist could not be read:

noteDrm.message: The stream is DRM-protected and cannot be downloaded.

noteLive.message: Live stream: only the segments available right now will be saved.

noteAudio.message: Audio is a separate track and will be saved as a second file.

noteDash.message: DASH streams are not supported; the link can be passed to yt-dlp or ffmpeg.

statusStreamStarted.message: Download started in a new tab

dlFailed.message: Segments that could not be downloaded:

dlLiveWarning.message: Live stream: only the segments available right now will be saved.

errDrm.message: The stream is DRM-protected (SAMPLE-AES / Widevine / FairPlay).

optNamingSmartHint.message: The original name from the server or link; when it is meaningless (index, playlist, a hash), the page title is used.

optNamingOriginalHint.message: Exactly the name given by the server or the link, even if it is "index" or "video".

optNamingTitleHint.message: The title of the page where the video was found.

optFolderHint.message: Leave empty to save directly to the Downloads folder.

optSaveAs.message: Ask where to save each file

optConcurrencyHint.message: 1–16. Higher is faster but some servers limit connections.

optAutoClose.message: Close the stream download tab when finished

optMinSizeHint.message: Smaller files (previews, interface sounds) are not listed.

warnNoConvert.message: MP4 conversion is not possible, the original format is kept:

optConvertMp4Hint.message: Without re-encoding; a separate audio track is merged into the same file. Unsupported codecs keep the original format (.ts).
